elevate.move: Make every photo frame the evidence end of the signature: report border, F-number tab cut into the corner, a red-pen circle drawn onto the defect in the image, and the margin pin's leader landing on that circle, so stock frames read as one inspector's evidence set, including the hero thumbnails.

Rebuild the hero as the report's cover spread across the full 1440: left page is the cover (Roof inspection, Fort Worth TX, h1 with the place, both actions, open-now + Sample rating, ZIP), right page is the pinned plan with its tally; the intro turns the page in under 1.2s, and on 390 a short live strip of the plan sits between h1 and buttons so the signature is in the phone's first screen.
